frames.title: Lesson 91 · Sophisticated concessions — practice and contrast

body: **Foco:** Concessões sofisticadas — prática e contraste.
**Verbos:** mitigate.
**Pronúncia:** Ajuste refinado de entonação.
**24 palavras novas** (discurso público).
**Texto do dia:** blog, diário, crônica.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo praticar e contrastar concessões sofisticadas (albeit, notwithstanding, much as, granted, adjetivo + as, whatever, no matter how) num blog, e usar mitigate.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

items: visita de fim de semana ao local

blocks.title: Diary of a First-Term Councillor: Week Nine
paras: **Granted**, I promised to answer every email within a day. **Try as I might**, I can’t: 140 arrived last week. **Notwithstanding** the volume, I replied to the urgent ones, **albeit** briefly. **Much as** I’d like to deliver everything, **whatever** I do, someone will feel unheard.

**Tired as I am**, I **spent Saturday** at the flooded estate. **No matter how** carefully we plan, the drains **overflow** at the first storm. We can’t **prevent** it entirely, but we can **mitigate** the damage: **clear the gutters, move vehicles, warn residents**. **Humble as** it sounds, that’s **governing**.

items.q: The councillor answered every email within a day.
items.why: Try as I might, I can’t.

items.q: The flooding can be prevented entirely.
The councillor spent Saturday at the flooded estate.
items.why: spent Saturday at the flooded estate.

Exemplo
Nuance
rows: **Tired as I am**, I went. **Try as I might**, I can’t.

blocks.body: *Although* pede **oração completa**; *notwithstanding* e *despite* pedem **substantivo/gerúndio**; *albeit* pede **adjetivo ou sintagma**. *Adj + as* inverte a ordem.
*Despite of* ✗ → *despite* ou *in spite of*. *Notwithstanding* pode vir antes ou depois: *the volume notwithstanding*.

items.s: ___ as I might, I can’t answer every email. (try)
___ the volume, I replied to urgent ones. (notwithstanding)
___ matter how carefully we plan, drains overflow. (no)
We can ___ the damage if not prevent it. (mitigate)

body: **Try as I might,…** — Por mais que eu tente,…
**Tired as I am,…** — Por mais cansado que esteja,…
**Whatever the cost,…** — Custe o que custar,…
**No matter how…** — Não importa quão…
**Come what may.** — Aconteça o que acontecer.
**Be that as it may.** — Seja como for.
**Make the best of.** — Tirar o melhor de.
**Keep one’s head above water.** — Manter a cabeça fora d’água.
**Weather the storm.** — Superar a tempestade.
**Soldier on.** — Seguir adiante apesar de tudo.
**You promised to reply to every email.** — Você prometeu responder a todos os e-mails.
**And the flooding?** — E a enchente?
**Granted, but try as I might, I can’t.** — É verdade, mas por mais que eu tente, não consigo.

items.label: Ajuste refinado de entonação
items.note: Ajuste refinado de entonação: pequenas variações de altura e de ritmo mudam a atitude (cortesia, ironia, reserva, compromisso) sem mudar as palavras.
words: I suppose that’s one way to put it. ↘↗ (reserva)
Well, that’s ONE way to put it. ↘ (ironia)

prompts.model: Try as I might, I cannot remember her name.
No matter how hard it rains, the match goes on.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence diary entry about a difficult week in public life or work, using at least four different concessive structures and mitigate.
blocks.model: Granted, the week began well. Tired as I was, I attended every meeting. Notwithstanding the delays, we signed the contract, albeit with changes. Much as I wanted a perfect result, no matter how hard we tried, some risk remained. We cannot remove it, but we can mitigate it. That, I suppose, is progress.

**constituent inbox** = caixa de entrada de eleitores.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
